page.layout: One page, blank except for library stamps. Top: a torn paper scrap, with mirrored and upside-down print. Centre and lower right: red library stamps. Faint show-through of the other side's text runs down the page.
page.notes: No printed text on this page that belongs to the book. The top scrap shows large bold print, mirrored and upside down, apparently "PHILOSOP[HIA] / CHRIST[IANA]" with a line "V F", too damaged and reversed to read reliably. It appears to be a pasted or offset fragment, not running text, so I have not transcribed it. The red stamps ("Ex Bibloth. Regia Berolinensi" and "VEND. EX BIBL. REG. BEROL.") are library stamps and are excluded. The faint grey lines are show-through and are excluded.
